title: Alibaba says Qwen4-Max, which isn't open weight, beats Fable 5.1 and Kimi K3.1 Pro in coding benchmarks, and plans to release weights for smaller Qwen4 models (Luz Ding/Bloomberg)
summary: Luz Ding / Bloomberg: Alibaba says Qwen4-Max, which isn't open weight, beats Fable 5.1 and Kimi K3.1 Pro in coding benchmarks, and plans to release weights for smaller Qwen4 models — Alibaba Group Holding Ltd. launched a new flagship AI model, claiming performance that rivals Anthropic PBC and OpenAI in China's latest challenge to US leaders.
